primaryQuery:
run: order_items -> {
  where: created_at >= @2022-01-01
  group_by: mo is created_at.month
  aggregate: sales is sale_price.sum()
  order_by: mo
  calculate: prev_month_sales is lag(sales)
} -> {
  where: mo < @2022-11-01 and prev_month_sales != null
  select:
    drop_month is month(mo)
    month_sales is sales
    prev_month_sales
    mom_change is round(sales - prev_month_sales, 2)
    mom_pct is round(sales / prev_month_sales - 1, 4)
  order_by: mom_pct asc
  limit: 1
}
variesAxis: self-join of a monthly query source on mo - 1 month
